name: Screen notices for the open bid queue
startingState: An official portal and the test queue are available. Prepare open, expired, closed, irrelevant, and deadline-unverifiable notices.
actions: Open each official notice and its latest published amendment, if any.
Check relevance, notice type, issuer, solicitation ID, response deadline, time zone where stated, and current status.
Submit each candidate through pilot screening and inspect the resulting queue.
expected: Only relevant public solicitations with a verified future deadline and an open status confirmed on the buyer's official portal can enter the open-bid queue.

assertions.backend: The intake records each admission or exclusion with its reason.

name: Reconcile extraction for every file
startingState: Stage three to five authorized files with source expectations recorded before processing, including an item schedule and a meaningful failure case.
actions: Check the staged manifest and processor version, then start one bounded batch.
Reconcile every input to its extraction JSON or explicit error.
Compare required fields and each requested item, quantity and unit with its source page. Check blank and conflicting values.
Read back review flags and source references for the affected fields and items.
expected: Every manifest file has a traceable result or explicit error. Each required field or item matches its cited source page or is flagged for review.

name: Review a draft with its source evidence
startingState: Load drafts with source evidence. Include an item schedule and a missing or conflicting field. Use the designated reviewer account.
actions: Open the draft in Salesforce and check issuer, solicitation ID, published deadline, stated time zone, requested items, source links, and review status.
Compare the review flags with the PDF and inspect the original and extraction JSON in authorized storage.
Open the source PDF from the draft and record a human pursuit decision.
Run QA-03a for the signed link path.
expected: The designated reviewer can verify the draft against its source, see uncertainty, and record a pursuit decision.

assertions.backend: Read back draft data, decision, durable PDF reference, and stored extraction JSON.

name: Enforce access to the exact source PDF
startingState: Deploy the View document action in the test environment and prepare users with and without the required record, object, or field access.
actions: As the authorized reviewer, select View document and compare the opened PDF with the draft source.
Repeat with each access restriction and confirm no link is issued.
Attempt a changed document reference and a direct request without authorization in the approved test environment.
Check that the link cannot access another object and fails after expiry. Inspect persistence and logs for leaked links.
expected: Only an authorized request receives a temporary link scoped to the exact approved PDF.

assertions.backend: Authorization binds the document and version. Expired links fail and signed URLs are absent from storage and logs.

name: Review a replay and an amendment
startingState: Start with one reviewed Solicitation and its original source. Prepare a replay and an amendment with the same solicitation identity.
actions: Submit the replay and the amendment. Inspect the existing Solicitation and both new document entries before review.
Open each PDF, record Duplicate or Amendment with notes, and approve only the amendment changes.
Read back reviewed data and all document references.
expected: One Solicitation keeps the original and both incoming documents, with reviewed fields changing only after amendment approval.

assertions.backend: Both arrivals initially have Needs Review status. Earlier documents remain accessible and reviewed values survive ingestion.

name: Link multiple Opportunities and count one bid
startingState: Prepare one Solicitation and three existing synthetic Opportunities. Make the Solicitation lookup and solicitation-based report available.
actions: On two Opportunities choose the same Solicitation and save. Leave the third lookup blank.
Open both linked records and the Solicitation related list. Confirm the third record still saves unlinked.
Run the solicitation-based report and read back the lookup values.
expected: Both linked Opportunities reference the same Solicitation, the third stays unlinked, and the solicitation-based report counts one bid.
